title: Bilevel Pressure Support (PS)
lesson: In bilevel PAP, pressure support is the difference between inspiratory positive airway pressure and expiratory positive airway pressure. Subtract EPAP from IPAP.
memoryClue: Pressure support is the gap between IPAP and EPAP.
coachBobNote: Keep the direction straight: IPAP is normally the higher pressure, so PS is IPAP minus EPAP.

workedExample.prompt: IPAP is 14 cm H2O and EPAP is 8 cm H2O. Find pressure support.

guided.prompt: IPAP 16 cm H2O and EPAP 10 cm H2O. Find PS.

commonErrors.message: Pressure support is a difference, not the sum of the two pressures.

guided.prompt: IPAP 18 cm H2O and EPAP 12 cm H2O. Find PS.
guided.success: Correct. Pressure support is 6 cm H2O.
